== Ingredients ==

* [[Cookbook:Potato|Potatoes]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* [[Cookbook:Peanut Oil|Groundnut oil]]

== Equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|Frying pan]]
* Cooking spoon
* Bowl 

== Procedure ==

# Rinse the potatoes and season with salt.
# Heat the oil in a pan, and add the potatoes when hot. Cook until golden all over, flipping as needed.
# Serve hot.
